name: vnoc
description: Browse code as a graph and attach docs to it (walking skeleton).

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode V-NOC ignores the executable paths set in workspace settings.

vnoc.server.path.description: Path to the vnoc core binary. Empty = the build folder of this repository (development). Ignored from workspace settings in Restricted Mode.

vnoc.driver.path.description: Path to the Python driver binary. Empty = the build folder of this repository (development). Ignored from workspace settings in Restricted Mode.
